title: Mary and Mr. Pomeroy
body:
In Scene II of 'Say the Right Thing', Mary is still looking out of the window when she sees a neighbour.
Mary: There's Mr. Pomeroy on his horse. He's always talking about horses. He rides a horse every day, and practises shooting. Why must he do that? What have they done to Mr. Pomeroy? Why do some men like horses more than they like people? It's hard to understand men.
Mrs. Lee: My brother practises shooting when he has the time, and he rides his horse when he can. He sold his house in London and bought a house here because he wanted to ride and practise shooting.
Mrs. Harding: (looking at Mrs. Lee) It's getting a little late. We must go now, Mrs. Shaw. It has been very nice to have a little talk. (She looks at Mary.)
